=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text hdr "Kaprekar numbers below 10000:"
text cnt "count of Kaprekar numbers below 1000000: "
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note n is Kaprekar when n * n splits as a * 10^k + b with b > 0 and a + b = n (1 counts by definition)
note bound: n < 10^6, so n * n < 10^12 and p walks at most 12 powers of ten
fn kap n ulong to bool
if eq n 1
ret true
end
sq = mul n n
p = ulong 10
while le p sq bound 20
b = rem sq p
if gt b 0
if eq add div sq p b n
ret true
end
end
p = mul p 10
end
ret false
end
fn main to int
emit hdr
c = ulong 0
for i ulong 999999
n = add i 1
if kap n
c = add c 1
if lt n 10000
emit sp
emitu n
end
end
end
emit nl
emit cnt
emitu c
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Kaprekar numbers below 10000: 1 9 45 55 99 297 703 999 2223 2728 4879 4950 5050 5292 7272 7777 9999
count of Kaprekar numbers below 1000000: 54
</pre>
